summary: ezbookkeeping is a lightweight personal finance application designed to run on your own infrastructure. It provides tools for tracking personal expenses, income, and overall monetary management through a self-hosted web interface.
goodFor: This is a suitable option if you want to track your personal finances locally without relying on third-party Software-as-a-Service platforms.
watchOut: As a niche personal bookkeeping tool, it has a smaller community and fewer integrations compared to established commercial alternatives or heavier open-source accounting suites.
deployNotes: Because it is distributed as a Docker container, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your financial data and place the service behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
